generation.scope: A repeated factor of a reduced finite opposite octic is a plane of multiplicity exactly two. Its residual sextic is geometrically integral and nonnormal. An integral quartic with a marked triple point has at most seven singular marks, and six marked triple points on an integral quintic form two skew collinear triples.

open_mathematics: Analyze the normalization and singular curves of the integral sextic with at least thirteen marked triple points, alongside all-degree regularity and exceptional middles.
